items.period: Shang period style; the page identifies the script style, not a securely dated specimen in the SVG itself
items.caption: Modern vector redraw of 大 in Shang oracle-bone script style. The file page cites Sinica specimen 43.E628 as a source; this is a script-form illustration, not an artifact photograph.
items.alt: Modern black-line vector of the character 大 in a Shang oracle-bone script style.
items.selection_reason: Provides a candidate early form relevant to the adult-human analysis; Commons identifies its source references and CC0 status.
items.rights: CC0 1.0 / public domain as stated on the Commons file page.

items.period: Early Western Zhou specimen is cited as a source; file depicts Western Zhou bronze-script style
items.caption: Modern vector redraw of 大 in Western Zhou bronze-script style. The Commons page cites an image associated with 作冊大方鼎 (early Western Zhou); this redraw is not a photograph of the vessel.
items.alt: Modern black-line vector of 大 in a Western Zhou bronze-script style.
items.selection_reason: Adds a bronze-script comparison and an early Western Zhou source reference; useful between the oracle-style and seal-style examples.
items.rights: Commons states the file is available under CC0 and separately lists Richard Sears permission/copyright information; verify terms at source before reuse.

items.period: Shuowen seal-script style; the digital file is a modern redraw
items.tradition: Seal script as represented in Shuowen-style reference forms
items.caption: Modern vector redraw of 大 in Shuowen seal-script style. It illustrates a later dictionary-script form and is not an ancient artifact photograph.
items.alt: Modern black-line vector of 大 in Shuowen seal-script style.
items.selection_reason: Provides a later comparison form alongside the oracle and bronze candidates; its cited sources and reuse terms are described on Commons.
items.rights: CC0 1.0 / public domain as stated on the Commons file page.

limitations.text: The candidate descriptions and their direct media links were inspected, but the browsing tool failed to retrieve the oracle and bronze SVG pixels and did not return usable oracle/bronze previews. No visual inspection is claimed. The seal preview link was returned, but the glyph itself was not assessed for visual details.

These files are modern vector redrawings identified by their Commons descriptions. Their script-style labels and cited source references should not be mistaken for direct inspection or dating of original artifacts.
